# TailwindCSS Smooth Shadow Plugin

Soft, multi-layered shadows that extend Tailwind’s shadow scale. Utilities include `smooth-shadow` plus sizes from `smooth-shadow-xs` up to `smooth-shadow-2xl`, and `smooth-shadow-none`. There is no `smooth-shadow-{color}` utility — tint the shadow with Tailwind’s own `shadow-{color}` (e.g. `smooth-shadow-md shadow-blue-500/50`), which the plugin reads via `--tw-shadow-color`. Untinted, it falls back to black.

## About

The Smooth Shadow Plugin is a tiny CSS-only Tailwind CSS plugin that replaces Tailwind’s flat, single-layer shadows with soft, multi-layered ones. Each `smooth-shadow` size stacks several blurred layers at falling opacity, so elevation reads as depth instead of a grey smudge. It ships as pure CSS utilities with no config and no runtime.

For elevated surfaces like cards, dialogs, popovers, dropdowns and menus, the `smooth-shadow-ring` utilities bake a 1px hairline ring into the shadow’s final layer. That avoids the double-border artifact you get from putting a `border` next to a `shadow` (a hard line with the shadow starting just outside it) and gives you a single, continuous edge. The ring and shadow tint independently via `smooth-ring-{color}` and `shadow-{color}`, and the ring adapts to dark mode automatically.
